text: Being here, I feel a curious energy. The glass-walled room evokes a sense of modernity and transparency; the neatness invites reflection. Stepping into the exhibit space, the bold colors and talk of "R+D" spark thoughts on progress and innovation. I am reminded of the ceaseless unfolding of human potential and the need to continually question how we relate to our evolving tools and spaces. There is anticipation, as though ideas are incubating all around me.
